parts.name: Pull-Out Handle
parts.Basic_description: This is the pull-out handle of the luggage, typically made of aluminum for strength and lightness.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to pull or push the luggage easily while walking.
parts.Movement_description: It can extend and retract telescopically along the vertical axis.

parts.name: Wheel
parts.Basic_description: A wheel of the luggage made of polyurethane for durability and smooth rolling.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the luggage and enables rolling movement on the ground.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its axle to allow forward and backward motion.
